superseded_study.reason: The user's subsequent edge-exiting KVM requirement excludes the former inward KVM position, even though it passes the narrower body/courtyard screen.

user_constraints.KVM: Right-angle exit at Hub top, right or bottom edge; never the native left edge.
user_constraints.added_cost: Modest added assembled BOM cost acceptable only if it enables a meaningful reduction of the actual matched assembly footprint.
user_constraints.stack: Use existing dead-bug gap; do not confuse board XY length with stack Z thickness.

KVM.failure: Already right-angle hardware, but its mouth faces into the board interior. Body-only stack validation did not enforce edge access.
KVM.new_generic_check: Evidence-defined mouth location/direction from numbered pads; verify external perimeter exit and allowed edges. Excludes internal holes and preserves pin-number identity on rotation. This is not cable/tool clearance qualification.
KVM.nearby_protection: F5 and D7 follow the connector to the top-edge region; the 470uF +5VSB bulk capacitor moves into the vacated lower region. Changed current paths still need independent reconstruction and receiving.

rejected_alternatives: 4mm ATX input move with rotated lower Hub reservoir encounters multiple capacitor-vent constraints; a uniform U6 support move does not solve them.
Bottom-edge KVM overlaps tall ATX input connector beneath it under the unchanged stack allocation.

Right-edge KVM can protrude enough to clear ATX input but widens the combined envelope. A flush right-edge attempt paired with shifting ATX input right5mm instead collides with the Hub's last RJ45 port.

busbar_decision.reason: No demonstrated meaningful XY reduction yet. Existing stack headroom means bar thickness is not itself disqualifying, but local body/vent/insulation and complete current paths must still clear.
busbar_decision.verified_low_cost_candidate: XFCN T200030-20-R / C55380739: 20x3x2mm tin-plated copper, flat SMT, not a raised THT bridge.

next_required: Verify mated KVM housing, wire and tool approach through the complete flipped stack.
Construct a private connected THT/power-cell repack; do not promote a footprint-only move.
Restore source-owned routes, current-rated force paths, protection topology and saved pours, preserving stack mates and pinout.
Run independent whole-board DRC/opens, current, Kelvin, bypass, return-path and mechanical receiving before replacing either reviewed board.
